parts.text: Explain the difference between research methods and research methodology.
Discuss the various steps involved in the research process.
Discuss the meaning and underpinnings of the scientific method in research.
Briefly discuss the importance of research.
Distinguish between conceptual and empirical research.
Explain the difference between qualitative and quantitative research approaches with relevant examples.
Briefly discuss the difference between descriptive research and analytical research.
Explain the various types of research design.
Discuss the various sampling methods used in research.
What are the guiding considerations in constructing a questionnaire?
